policy.source_priority: Authored Phantom and compatible Unity assets first; already-imported owned Fab/Quixel semantic matches are promoted into stable aliases; curated current CC0 creator packs provide deterministic coverage; V8/V9/V10 local production art is fallback support, never Engine primitive geometry.
policy.candidate_gate: cook to CandidateBuilds/V11, launch each actual packaged game once at 1920x1080, capture actual gameplay, validate world actor-density report plus visual frame detail, then promote transactionally with rollback

curated_sources.owned_fab_policy: Harvest only assets already imported into the current project; never scrape credentials or protected download endpoints.

visual_quality_gate.source_priority: Authored Phantom assets and already-imported owned Fab/Quixel semantic matches are preferred where compatible; current Kenney/KayKit/Quaternius creator libraries provide verified CC0 coverage; V9 generated setpieces are guaranteed deterministic production content, not primitive fallbacks; missing required art blocks packaging.

pipeline.unity_baseline: scan packages/phantom-games-unity and preserve compatible source assets/mechanics instead of treating Unreal as a blank rewrite
pipeline.owned_fab: harvest already-imported owned Fab/Quixel/Marketplace assets into stable semantic aliases; never scrape credentials or protected download URLs
pipeline.creator_assets: resolve current first-party Kenney pages and current KayKit GitHub main branches; optional Quaternius packs staged when creator downloads are available
pipeline.persistent_worlds: BuildProductionWorlds.py creates four real /Game/Phantom/Worlds/*.umap assets after all imports in the same UnrealEditor-Cmd session
pipeline.candidate_gate: cook to CandidateBuilds/V9, launch actual packaged gameplay once per game at 1920x1080, reject obviously blank/flat frames, then promote transactionally with rollback
